tools.name: search_announcements
tools.description: Search DiscoverIA's registry of AI-assisted scientific claims by free text, status, lab, discipline and announcement date. Returns paginated entries with their current status, the date that status was observed and a link to the entry's page. A status says where the evaluation of a claim stands, not

tools.name: get_announcement
tools.description: Get one entry of the DiscoverIA registry by id: claim, claimant, current status with its rule, dated status history with sources, verifiers, links, statement fidelity, events, related frontiers and the plain-language summary. A status says where the evaluation stands, not whether the result is true.

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.description: List DiscoverIA's six evaluation statuses for scientific claims (and the provisional product statuses) with their definitions and the number of entries in each. A status says where the evaluation stands, not whether the result is true.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Latest status changes in the registry (last 90 days, with source) and the latest items of DiscoverIA's feed (last 30 days: sciences, models and labs, apps, devices).

tools.name: get_frontier
tools.description: Frontiers track the best known bound of a quantity (e.g. a kissing number) and who moved it. With an id: the frontier, its current lower and upper records (exact values as strings, never rounded) and its series. Without an id: the list of frontiers with their current records.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Dated citation of a registry entry in APA and/or BibTeX, with its status and the date that status was observed. Data are CC BY 4.0, credit DiscoverIA.
